Taken verbatim out of TeachingPhilosophyPage.astro, where every one of these
sentences was written straight into the markup. Nothing is reworded here; the
WARNING: TYPOGRAPHY IS NOT STORED. The curly quotation marks around a quote,
the 01-05 numerals, the line break in the closing heading and the italic on its
second line are all in the page. An editor types the words; the design puts the
quotes round them. Storing them would mean an editor could delete one and leave
the other, and every one of them would have to be retyped by hand.
Inline emphasis uses the marks RichLine already reads across this project:
*italic* and **bold**. Raw HTML is never stored.

school's name has one source and not seven.

sectionOne.heading: Recognising
sectionOne.quote: All the students do not have the same talents and so each one will achieve success differently.
body: That sentence is where the school's teaching begins. If success is not one shape, a lesson cannot be one shape either — and a class is not a room of the same child repeated.

sectionTwo.heading: Guiding every learner towards their strengths
sectionTwo.quote: We, educators being as a facilitators should always encourage our child to develop in their specific field of interest.
body: A facilitator does not hand down the subject. The word the school chose puts the teacher beside the learner rather than in front of them — encouraging the direction a child is already leaning in, rather than correcting it towards an average.

sectionThree.heading: More than one way to learn
body: The school names the theory outright — *“a theory of Multiple Intelligence”* — as one of the three things it says it incorporates in all areas of teaching. What follows from it is simple: a class does not hold one kind of mind, so it should not be offered one kind of route in.
sectionThree.imageAlt: Students of {schoolName} working on embroidery together

sectionFour.heading: Learning through interaction
body: Collaborative learning is the third of the three the school says it incorporates *in all areas of teaching* — not in a timetabled slot. The Principal's own description of the result is a room where children are talking to each other: **“classrooms are places of curiosity and collaboration”**.
sectionFour.imageAlt: Students together on the ground at {schoolName}

sectionFive.heading: Teaching that evolves with the learner
body: Technology is the first of the three the school names, and the Principal describes the intent rather than the hardware: a school where **“innovative teaching methods meet modern technology”**.
The philosophy is that teaching should keep moving — that a method earns its place by making a subject more reachable, not by being new. What that looks like in a room is a separate page.
sectionFive.imageAlt: The computer laboratory at {schoolName}, rows of workstations facing an interactive board

close.quote: Every child feels valued, safe, and inspired to achieve their full potential.
